P0.blast_radius: Wrong verdict would bind program architecture, owner constraints, or an anti-adoption / durability / release-level rule.
P0.label: architectural commitment
P0.waiver_vehicle: Named waiver in command-center/OWNER-DECISIONS.md. Unanswered owner questions stay DEFERRED and fail closed. The authoring unit cannot lower a P0 bar.

P1.blast_radius: Wrong verdict would bind a gate, a claim family, or a format choice inherited by other units.
P1.label: load-bearing / family-binding
P1.waiver_vehicle: Owner waiver, or an independent adversarial reviewer with a named waiver record. Not the authoring unit.

P2.blast_radius: Wrong verdict changes one unit's conclusion.
P2.label: ordinary research claim
P2.waiver_vehicle: Independent reviewer recorded on the artifact. Author may not self-lower. Executable check is required when independent sources < 2.

P3.label: note / local observation
P3.waiver_vehicle: Authoring unit may mark NOT-CHECKED. It may not mark CONFIRMED without meeting the P2 bar.

calibration_reason: At least one existing high-severity claim sits BELOW the bar, the P3/P0 thin-payload control fires, and the status-quo zero-bar mutant is rejected.

rows.text: accept() with no minimum argument enforces REQUIRED_MIN; a mutation of that constant must fail a test that omits minimum=.
rows.why_severity: accept() floor is a command-center gate other tests inherit.

rows.text: A test that only passes minimum= explicitly does not protect REQUIRED_MIN; mutating the default must SURVIVE it and register a hole.
rows.why_severity: Defines a coverage hole other mutation tests inherit.

rows.text: A test with no mutation record is UNPROVEN and must not count toward any coverage total.
rows.why_severity: Local scoring rule for one test family.

rows.text: A conda-style channel index whose lookup unit is one JSON file (repodata.json) survives a git-file index: git can version that file and a client can resolve packages by reading it.
rows.why_severity: Ecosystem index-shape fact; one unit's conclusion.

rows.text: Cargo's git registry index does not survive a single-JSON git-file index: the catalog is a sharded per-crate file tree.
rows.why_severity: Ecosystem index-shape fact; one unit's conclusion.

rows.text: npm registry.md's statement that you can run any compatible registry is sufficient to claim that npm's index is a git JSON file.
rows.why_severity: Meta-rule: a single prose rail is not citable as measured fact.
